family.semantic_notes: 'Pasture' strongly implies agricultural use for grazing livestock, while 'meadow' often evokes natural wildflowers and poetic landscapes.

source_context_dev: The valley opened up into an immense stretch of wild grass extending as far as the eye could see. Not a single tree or building broke the sweeping, limitless horizon.
Under the wide sky, miles of uninterrupted grassy expanse reached toward the distant mountain range. The morning light highlighted just how boundless the countryside truly was.
A seemingly endless expanse of open turf dominated the rural landscape, disappearing into the haze at the edge of sight. Travelers often marveled at the sheer scale of the untamed terrain.
From the elevated ridge, the open grassy floor below looked virtually infinite. The sweeping terrain stretched endlessly between the two borders of the county.
target_context_dev: Gentle knolls and flowing grassy ridges shaped the local dairy farm's undulating landscape. Warm sunlight highlighted the rhythm of rising crests and shallow dips.
The agrarian land rose and dipped in soft swells across the agricultural estate. From atop each grassy ridge, another graceful slope descended into the hollow.
Wavy mounds and sloping contours defined the topography of the local cattle operation. Shadows gathered softly in the hollows between the gentle grassy rises.
The countryside undulated in sweeping waves of grassy hillocks and dips. The dairy district was famous for these sculptural, undulating ground formations.
source_context_test: The rural valley broadened into a wide, borderless span of open turf beneath the afternoon sun. Horizon lines faded into the distance without any visible barriers.
Looking out from the highway, the boundless carpet of wild turf seemed to have no end. The panoramic view offered an uninterrupted line of sight across many leagues.
Huge swaths of untamed territory covered the lowland plain, providing miles of unbroken openness. The sheer breadth of the surrounding country was breathtaking.
The landscape unfolded in every direction with boundless reach and unhindered breadth. The open rural terrain seemed to blend right into the distant skyline.
target_context_test: Softly curving ridges and pleasant grassy hollows characterized the dairy property. Each gentle incline led smoothly to another dip in the undulating farm grounds.
The agricultural acreage followed the rhythmic rise and fall of the hillside terrain. Grassy crests dipped gradually toward shaded ravines throughout the homestead.
Curving slopes and undulating turf formed the backbone of the rural homestead. Sunlight played across the continuous series of mounds and shallow swales.
The topography of the livestock property was defined by rhythmic, undulating swells of ground. Ridges and depressions alternated in smooth succession across the land.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations (vast meadow, vast pasture, rolling meadow, rolling pasture) are semantically valid and grammatically sound under all contexts. The source contexts bias toward scale and wild expansiveness, favoring vast/meadow, while target contexts emphasize undulating topography and agrarian terrain, favoring rolling/pasture.

source_context_dev: Heavy spring showers had invigorated the soil, producing an emerald carpet bursting with fresh vitality. The rich verdure shone vividly beneath the morning sun.
Lush vegetation coated the countryside in brilliant emerald hues after weeks of gentle rain. The vibrant color of the stalks was strikingly fresh and vivid.
